name: Semantic Misdirection to Directed Graphs
description: I replaced the algebraic constraints with a logical constraint about assigning directions to edges (links) and modes to vertices (servers). By defining modes as 'Transmitter' (all edges outgoing) and 'Receiver' (all edges incoming), the problem mathematically enforces that every edge connects different modes, perfectly preserving the 2-coloring structure. However, the semantic framing strongly triggers directed graph concepts (topological sort, flow, 2-SAT) rather than undirected bipartite coloring, forcing models to genuinely reason about the logical equivalence rather than relying on keyword-based pattern matching.
